title.exam: FIFTH SEMESTER (CUFYUGP) DEGREE EXAMINATION: MODEL PAPER 1
title.subject: PHYSICS / APPLIED PHYSICS
title.module: Module 1: Electric and Magnetic Fields in Matter

sections.name: Section A
sections.rule: All Questions can be answered. Each Question carries 3 marks (Ceiling: 24 Marks)
questions: Write down the relation connecting polarization and electric field in linear dielectrics. What do you mean by a polar dielectric?
Give the relation connecting permittivity and susceptibility in linear dielectrics. Explain the terms involved. How is relative permittivity connected to susceptibility?
Explain physically why a string of head-to-tail dipoles leaves net charge at its two ends.
Write down Gauss’s law in presence of a dielectric.
State the boundary condition on $D^\perp$ and on $\mathbf D^\parallel$ at an interface, in terms of free charge and polarization.
Distinguish between permeability and permittivity.
What is the basic difference between electric and magnetic polarizations?
Explain physically why a uniformly magnetized slab carries a surface current, although each atom carries only a tiny loop current.
Discuss the magnetic field inside matter.
Explain the temperature-driven phase transitions in ferromagnetic materials.

sections.name: Section B
sections.rule: All Questions can be answered. Each Question carries 6 marks (Ceiling: 36 Marks)
questions: Show that the energy of an ideal dipole $\vec p$ in an electric field $\vec E$ is given by $U = -\vec p\cdot\vec E$.
Derive the expression for capacitance of a parallel plate capacitor with partially filled dielectric.
Explain the hysteresis loop of ferromagnets.
Explain the domain model of ferromagnets.
Write an expression for the field of a magnetized object. Explain the terms involved.

A solid sphere of radius $2$ cm is uniformly polarized with $P=1.0\times10^{-6}$ C/m$^2$. Find the field inside the sphere and the dipole moment of the sphere. Take $\varepsilon_0=8.85\times10^{-12}$ F/m.
A uniformly magnetized sphere of radius $5$ cm has $M=1.0\times10^{4}$ A/m. Find the magnetic field inside the sphere and its magnetic dipole moment. Take $\mu_0=4\pi\times10^{-7}$ H/m.

A long solenoid with $n=1000$ turns/m carries a current $I=2$ A and is filled with a linear material of $\chi_m=2\times10^{-5}$. Find $\mathbf H$, $\mathbf B$ inside, and the bound surface current density on the surface of the material.

sections.name: Section C
sections.rule: Answer any ONE. Each Question carries 10 marks (1x10=10 Marks)
questions: Explain the terms polarization and displacement. Derive the relation connecting them. Derive an expression for potential of polarized objects.

Discuss in detail Ampère’s law in magnetized materials. Derive an expression for the magnetic field at any point inside and outside of a long copper rod of radius $R$ carrying a uniformly distributed current $I$.
